blurb: Guests jump on trampolines, play arcade games, and can celebrate birthdays with party packages. There is a dedicated toddler area called Space Camp for children 6 and under. The park offers food and drinks at a full service café and requires special Cosmic socks for jumping.
extraNote: No outside food or drinks allowed except birthday cakes (no ice cream cakes) with purchase of food and drinks · Day pass allows re-entry on the date of purchase only · No charge for spectators · 10% service charge on birthday parties covers gratuity, paper goods, setup and cleanup
